visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Four clear plastic bottles are arranged radially on a vibrant blue background, with their necks pointing toward a dark grey sea turtle figurine at the center. A yellow speech bubble logo with 'QUALY' appears in the top right. White text captions appear at the bottom. (2) A close-up shows two turtle-shaped coasters, one light grey and one dark grey, on a dark wooden surface; a person's hand places a glass of water on the light grey one. (3) Multiple turtle figurines in different shades of grey are scattered on a blue surface with a piece of green fishing net on the left. (4) Real-world underwater footage shows a sea turtle swimming and attempting to eat a translucent plastic bag floating in the water. (5) A hand holds and crumbles a piece of clear plastic film against a neutral background. (6) A white and a black turtle coaster are presented statically on the blue studio background. (7) Real underwater footage shows a sea turtle swimming while being heavily entangled in a green plastic fishing net. (8) On a blue background, pieces of transparent plastic are pulled away from the grey turtle figurine, symbolizing recycling. (9) A hand places a silver paperclip onto the shell of the grey turtle figurine, where it sticks due to internal magnets. (10) Three turtle figurines (light grey, dark grey, black) are mounted on a beige wall; a hand inserts a key into a slot on the dark grey turtle's shell. (11) A hand holds a black turtle figurine and inserts a pair of scissors into it, revealing it as a specialized holder. (12) A penguin-shaped soap dispenser in grey and white is shown in front of green netting. (13) The penguin soap dispenser is shown with three clear plastic bottles placed behind it to link the product to its source material. (14) An outdoor scene shows a picnic setup in a park with two green and grey plastic storage bins on a white cloth in the grass. (15) The video returns to the blue background with the turtle figurine and bottles, displaying the final slogan and brand mission text.
